description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Founding Engineer focused on recommendation systems, you will build the machine learning layer of an AI-powered recruiting marketplace. You will own matching, ranking, and retrieval systems that help connect candidates with relevant roles.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own recommendation, ranking, and retrieval systems from design through production.

 - Build and improve LLM-powered candidate-role matching.

 - Turn product problems into production features and ship at a rapid cadence.

 - Design and maintain the data pipelines and services that support production models.

 - Work directly with company leadership to translate product goals into shipped systems.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Two to five years of software engineering experience building and shipping end-to-end production features.

 - Production experience with recommender systems, ranking algorithms, or ML-powered matching.

 - Hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered features using LLM APIs.

 - Strong production engineering skills in TypeScript or Python, with experience using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent ML frameworks.

 - Experience deploying ML models or ML-powered products and maintaining production data pipelines and services.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals and comfort with fast-paced, iterative startup environments.

 - Experience with React, Supabase, Prisma, search and ranking infrastructure, embeddings, vector search, or workflow automation tools is beneficial.

 - Demonstrated technical achievement through education, open-source contributions, or personal projects is a plus.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is $130,000 to $170,000 annually, plus equity. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California, six days per week. Relocation assistance is available.
